_comment: Single source of truth for the software apps shipped by this monorepo. Consumed by scripts/build_site.py (GitHub Pages landing page + deploy copy list) and scripts/publish_portfolio.py (portfolio cards + Obsidian notes). `description` is the full portfolio-card copy (HTML-ready); `desc` is the short landing-page blurb. `links` are relative to the deployed site root (https://juwpegatron.github.io/projects/<rel>). Extra fields `image_alt`, `project_id`, `label` (thumbnail aria-label) and `desc` reproduce the live markup verbatim.

apps.name: Twin
apps.desc: Learn, practice and (optionally) trade for real — guest mode, Twin Academy lessons, Replay Lab and pro order types
apps.description: Twin (formerly Trade Twin) is an iPhone-ready investing and trading companion. Continue as guest without login or share a ?guest invite link, then save progress later. Practice with a separate $10,000 portfolio using market, limit, stop, stop-limit and trailing orders with brackets, price alerts, scrub-to-read charts with SMA/EMA/RSI, portfolio X-ray and a bar-by-bar Replay Lab. Twin Academy adds 12 interactive lessons with quizzes, points, badges and a completion card. Optional real trading through your own Alpaca account on the local Python server (paper by default; live needs password + confirmation phrase, per-order caps and preview/confirm). Guests use a dated snapshot; the web demo never asks for broker keys. Not financial advice.
apps.image_alt: Twin v1.3: Twin Academy lesson, scrub chart with bracket order ticket and real-trading connection

apps.name: Glow
apps.desc: One home for your AI: GlowChat for chat, personas, a Council with a Judge and a model Arena; GlowRoom for an AI crew that researches, codes and reports back. One free Glow account, no sign-up needed to start
apps.description: Glow is a small AI ecosystem with one home and one account. GlowChat: chat with free AI right away, pick any model, use personas like Planner for tickable checklists, let a Council debate while a Judge summarizes, or compare and fuse models in an Arena. GlowRoom: give a goal to an AI crew in a live 3D office; they search the web, run code and report back with sources. Start from Glow home, switch apps from any app, and hand work between them. Free AI for guests, no sign-up needed.
apps.image_alt: Glow: GlowChat council with a Judge, part of the Glow ecosystem with GlowRoom
